home.pageTitle: Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) – Official Gaming Community
home.heroBadge: 🌐 Piyade World • Piyade Dünyası Official Community
home.heroSubtitle: Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) is the official bilingual Discord gaming community uniting Roblox, CS2, Zula, and TLauncher (Minecraft) players under one roof.
home.gamesSubheading: Get dedicated game roles, voice channels, and teammates for your favorite titles in the Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) Discord community.
home.gameRobloxDesc: Team up safely with verified Roblox accounts in Piyade World, join community events, and hang out in dedicated voice rooms.
home.gameCs2Desc: Join Piyade World CS2 players for competitive matches, 5v5 lobbies, and tactical team communication.
home.gameZulaDesc: Squad up with Piyade World Zula players for custom matches, community tournaments, and daily team play.
home.gameMinecraftDesc: Explore survival worlds, creative builds, and mini-game nights with Piyade World Minecraft (TLauncher) players.
home.whySubheading: More than a standard Discord server, Piyade World offers a modern gaming portal synchronized with our custom Discord bot.
home.why1Desc: With a single Piyade World membership, unlock dedicated roles and channels for Roblox, CS2, Zula, and Minecraft.
home.why2Desc: Applications submitted on our site go straight to the Piyade Discord bot, automatically assigning Cengaver, Verified Account, and game roles upon approval.
home.why3Desc: Clear community rules, fair moderation, and an automatic 30-day amnesty system ensure a respectful and toxic-free atmosphere.
home.why4Desc: Full Turkish (Piyade Dünyası) and English (Piyade World) support welcomes players from Turkey and around the world.
home.faqHeading: Frequently Asked Questions About Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası)
home.faqSubheading: Answers to the most common questions about the Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) gaming community, registration, and roles.
home.faq1A: Piyade World (also known in Turkish as Piyade Dünyası) is an official bilingual gaming community and web portal uniting Roblox, Counter-Strike 2 (CS2), Zula, and TLauncher (Minecraft) players on Discord.
home.faq2Q: Which games are supported in Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası)?
home.faq2A: Our community actively supports Roblox, CS2, Zula, and TLauncher (Minecraft). During registration, you can select one or all of these games to receive dedicated Discord roles.
home.faq3Q: How do I register for the Piyade World Discord server and which roles do I get?
home.faq3A: Sign in with Discord on our Register (/kayit) page, choose the games you play, and submit your game usernames. Once approved by staff, you automatically receive Cengaver, Verified Account, and your selected game roles.
home.faq4Q: Is joining Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) free?
home.faq4A: Yes, joining the Piyade World (Piyade Dünyası) gaming community, registering your game accounts, and participating in community events is completely free.

chat.privacyPageTitle: Chat Privacy & Safety Policy — Piyade World
chat.heading: Chat
chat.subtitle: General Chat group and private member messaging
chat.consentIntro: Piyade World Chat offers a shared General Chat group and private one-to-one messaging for registered Discord and site members. Please review and accept the rules and privacy terms below before continuing:
chat.consentPoint1: Messages and attached files are automatically and permanently deleted after 30 days. Location and camera metadata (EXIF) is automatically stripped from uploaded photos.
chat.consentPoint2: Messages in the mandatory "General Chat" group are public to everyone with chat access, while private DMs are visible only to the two participants. Your game usernames are optionally displayed on your profile card and can be hidden anytime in settings.
chat.consentPoint3: For safety, only messages reported by a user or flagged by the automated safety filter may be reviewed by Community Official moderators. Chats are never routinely monitored, and all moderator access is recorded in an audit log.
chat.consentPoint4: You can block any member with one click and report rule-breaking DM or group messages at any time. Group admins may remove rule-breaking messages in General Chat only and never gain access to private DMs.
chat.consentPoint5: Be respectful to fellow members; the Piyade World General Rules apply inside Chat as well.

chat.privacyIntro: Piyade World Chat provides a shared General Chat group and private one-to-one messaging for registered Discord and site members.
chat.privacySection1Body: Messages and uploaded attachments are stored on the server's persistent volume and permanently removed 30 days after sending via a daily automated cleanup job. Location and camera metadata (EXIF) is automatically stripped from uploaded JPEG photos before saving.
chat.privacySection2Title: 2. Who Can See Messages & Profile Cards
chat.privacySection2Body: Messages posted in the mandatory "General Chat" group are visible to everyone with chat access; env-configured group admins may delete rule-breaking group messages (logged without message content in the audit log) but gain zero access to private DMs. Private one-to-one messages are visible solely to the two participants. Game usernames on profile cards depend on each member's privacy toggle and are never transmitted when hidden.
chat.privacySection3Body: Chats are never routinely monitored. Only when a user submits a report or our local safety filter flags content may Community Official moderators review the copied case snapshot, and every moderator access is recorded in an audit log.
chat.privacySection4Body: In private chats you can mutually disable read receipts, close incoming messages, hide your game usernames, mute group notifications, block members, or delete your own messages. Piyade World General Rules apply in both General Chat and DMs.

chat.privacySection5Body: When a message is reported, the surrounding 30 messages (±5 for auto-flags) and attachments are copied as a case snapshot and preserved during review even if deleted by the sender. Closed case snapshots are permanently purged within 7 days, and open cases are auto-closed and purged after at most 90 days. Sanction and audit logs (with zero message content) may be retained for 1 year. Our local auto-filter scans text only (images/videos are not scanned) and never blocks sending.
chat.privacySection6Body: You may close incoming messages, hide game usernames, delete your own messages, or block members at any time. To appeal moderation actions or submit privacy inquiries, please contact staff on Discord or use the KVKK Request Form.

googleAuth.loginCenterDesc: Sign in with Discord, or continue with Google to become a direct site member without needing a Discord account.
googleAuth.btnDiscordSub: Continue with your Discord roles, registration status, and My Activity panel.
googleAuth.btnGoogleSub: Join directly as a site member without Discord, or link an existing Discord account.
googleAuth.loginCenterPrivacyNote: Your Google email and Google name are never shown to other users, and your Google profile photo is never stored.
googleAuth.hasDiscordPageTitle: Do You Have Discord? — Piyade World
googleAuth.hasDiscordTitle: Do you have a Discord account?
googleAuth.hasDiscordDesc: If you already have a Discord account you can link it to this Google login; otherwise create a direct site membership in a few quick steps.
googleAuth.hasDiscordYesTitle: Yes, I have a Discord account
googleAuth.hasDiscordYesDesc: Sign in with Discord to permanently link this Google account. Future Google logins will automatically continue with your Discord account.
googleAuth.hasDiscordNoDesc: Pick the games you play, choose a nickname, and join Piyade World directly as a site member.
googleAuth.welcomeFlashDesc: Your site membership is ready. You can manage your settings anytime from your profile.
googleAuth.noticeDiscordContinue: Your Google account is linked to Discord — continuing with your Discord account.
googleAuth.noticeGoogleLinked: Your Google account is now permanently linked to your Discord account.
googleAuth.errCancelledDesc: You cancelled Google sign-in. You can try again anytime from the sign-in center.
googleAuth.errStateDesc: The OAuth security state did not match or expired. Please try again from the sign-in center.
googleAuth.errTokenDesc: The identity response from Google could not be verified. Please try again in a moment.
googleAuth.errEmailUnverifiedDesc: For security, only Google accounts with a verified email address may sign in.
googleAuth.errReauthMismatchDesc: To confirm account deletion, please re-authenticate with the same Google account currently signed in.
googleAuth.errDisabledDesc: Google Sign-In is not configured on this server. You can still sign in with Discord.
googleAuth.accountSuspendedDesc: Your site member account has been temporarily suspended. You may submit an inquiry or appeal through our legal channels.
googleAuth.accountBannedDesc: Your site member account has been permanently closed under community rules. You may submit an appeal or KVKK data request using the legal links below.
googleAuth.linkConflictDesc: This Discord account is already linked to a different Google account. For security, a Discord account cannot be linked to two Google accounts.

googleSignup.pageTitle: Join as Site Member — Piyade World
googleSignup.heading: Join Piyade World
googleSignup.subheading: Become a community member in 4 quick steps — no Discord account required.
googleSignup.step0Desc: Select your age group and review each separate consent box individually.
googleSignup.parentConsentLabel: I have obtained permission from my parent or legal guardian to join this site.
googleSignup.consentKvkkLabel: I have read and understood the KVKK Privacy Notice.
googleSignup.consentRulesLabel: I have read and agree to the Piyade World General Rules.
googleSignup.step2Desc: Choose your community nickname and enter your usernames for the games you selected.
googleSignup.nicknameHelp: 2–32 characters. Mentions (@), links, invite URLs, and profanity are not allowed.
googleSignup.step3Desc: Review your details and complete your site membership.
googleSignup.summaryNoRobloxNote: Since Roblox is not selected, only your nickname will be displayed.
googleSignup.summaryPrivacyNote: Your Google email and Google name stay private and your Google photo is never stored. You can delete your account anytime from Profile.
googleSignup.errSessionExpired: Your temporary Google verification expired. Please sign in again.
googleSignup.errUnder13: Users under 13 cannot join Piyade World due to legal and child safety requirements.
googleSignup.errParentConsentRequired: Users aged 13–17 must confirm parent/guardian permission.
googleSignup.errKvkkRequired: Please confirm that you have read the KVKK Privacy Notice.
googleSignup.errTransferRequired: Cross-border transfer consent (Item C) is required to create an account.
googleSignup.errRulesRequired: Please accept the General Rules to continue.
googleSignup.errNickLength: Nickname must be between 2 and 32 characters.
googleSignup.errNickMention: Mentions (@) are not allowed in nicknames.
googleSignup.errNickLink: Links or Discord invites are not allowed in nicknames.
googleSignup.errNickProfanity: Inappropriate language is not allowed in nicknames.
googleSignup.errRobloxVerifyRequired: When Roblox is selected, you must verify your Roblox account using 'Check' before continuing.
googleSignup.errGoogleAlreadyRegistered: A site membership already exists for this Google account.
googleSignup.errBotOffline: The main community service (Bot API) is currently unreachable. Account creation is paused temporarily to protect uniqueness; please try again shortly.
googleSignup.errCreateFailed: Could not create your membership due to a conflict or error. Please check your details and try again.
googleSignup.errRateLimited: You have reached the hourly new membership limit (3). Please try again in an hour.

googleProfile.privacyDesc: Control what other registered members can see on your chat profile.
googleProfile.toggleShowGamesLabel: Show my game usernames on my chat profile
googleProfile.toggleShowGamesHelp: When turned off, your game usernames are hidden from your chat profile card.
googleProfile.privacyEmailHidden: Your Google email and Google name are never shown to other users anywhere.
googleProfile.privacyNoGooglePhoto: Your Google profile photo is never stored on our server.
googleProfile.consentsDesc: View your explicit consent choices and withdraw or re-grant any item at any time.
googleProfile.withdrawImpactA: Withdrawing disables Chat access until you re-grant this consent or delete your account.
googleProfile.withdrawImpactB: Withdrawing immediately hides your game usernames on your chat profile without affecting other site features.
googleProfile.withdrawImpactC: Withdrawing ends international infrastructure processing, halting chat and account usage; we recommend using Delete Account to erase all data.
googleProfile.withdrawSuggestDelete: You withdrew a required consent. If you wish to permanently erase your account and data, use the Delete Account section below.
googleProfile.transferWithdrawnBannerDesc: To keep using Chat and your account, please re-grant Item C below, or permanently erase your account via Delete Account.
googleProfile.sessionsDesc: Up to 5 remembered devices allowed to auto-sign in are listed here. Revoke any unrecognized device with one click.
googleProfile.deleteDesc: Deleting your account permanently erases your site member record, all remembered devices, chat profile, your own messages and unpreserved files, blocklist entries, and Roblox claim. Only an identity-free audit entry remains.
googleProfile.deleteModExceptionNote: Privacy exception: Copied snapshots inside reported or auto-flagged moderation cases remain until their scheduled retention period expires.
googleProfile.deleteStep1Desc: For security, confirm your identity with Google within the last 10 minutes before deleting.
googleProfile.deleteStep2Label: Type your exact account name to confirm:
googleProfile.flashGamesShown: Your game usernames are now visible on your chat profile.
googleProfile.flashGamesHidden: Your game usernames are now hidden on your chat profile.
googleProfile.flashConsentWithdrawnGeneric: Your consent choice has been withdrawn.
googleProfile.flashConsentAWithdrawn: You withdrew Item A consent. Chat access is unavailable without this consent; you may re-grant it or delete your account below.
googleProfile.flashConsentBWithdrawn: You withdrew Item B consent. Your game usernames are now hidden on your chat profile.
googleProfile.flashConsentCWithdrawn: You withdrew Item C (cross-border transfer) consent. Account and chat usage cannot continue without it; we recommend Delete Account below.
googleProfile.flashSessionRevoked: The selected device session was revoked.
googleProfile.flashAllSessionsRevoked: All remembered device sessions have been revoked.
googleProfile.errDeleteReauthRequired: You must re-authenticate with Google (within the last 10 minutes) before deleting your account.
googleProfile.errDeleteNameMismatch: The account name you entered does not exactly match your current account name.
googleProfile.noticeAccountDeleted: Your account and all personal data have been permanently deleted.
